messages:
mia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem last night. We saw recurring p99 spikes during scale-ups. Need an SLO publication plan, playbook edits, owners, and concrete timelines before next sprint.

eric: I can own the playbook updates (detection -> mitigation -> comms). Will add a short checklist and links to runbooks. ETA: 3 business days.

jamie: I'll draft the temporary SLO text/customer blurb. Proposal: text-gen public p99 = 310ms (30-day rolling) as a temporary target until infra fixes land. Include rollback triggers.

tomas: I'll take runtime changes: bump batching window, adjust KV-cache warmup, and add a fast-fallback route to smaller model. Short-term PR ~12 days, plus an integration test. Need a dev GPU for profiling.

slo-bot: Created ticket SRE-8001: "followup/slo-playbook-integration-scale-spikes" with checklist and assignees.

eric: Playbook outline I'll add: 1) detection signals (p99 spike + error-budget burn), 2) quick mitigations (pause non-critical traffic, enable fallback), 3) rollback steps for canaries, 4) comms template for customers.

jamie: Draft PromQL samples I'll put in the ticket for alerts:
```
# p99 spike (5m eval)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=\"text-gen\"}[5m])) by (le)) > 0.31

# error-budget burn (1h window)
(sum(increase(requests_total{route=\"text-gen\",status!~\"5..\"}[1h])) / sum(increase(requests_total{route=\"text-gen\"}[1h]))) < 0.985
```
I'll refine thresholds after staging.

mia: Milestones to add to SRE-8001: playbook + alerts by 2027020000 (48h), dashboards in prod by 2027020000, runtime PR opened by 2027040000 (12 days), integration tests by 2027080000 (4 weeks). Add weekly 15m check-ins for the first 2 weeks post-deploy.

tomas: Added the integration test plan and requested infra resources. I'll post the profiling notes in the ticket.

eric: I'll also add a short customer-facing paragraph for product/comms and a template incident header for status pages.

jamie: Once dashboards + rollback automation exist in prod, I can sign-off on publishing the temporary SLO and notify customers.

mia: Thanks — please update SRE-8001 with exact rollback criteria and the signal definitions. I'll do final approval after those are present. :white_check_mark:
